scenarios.name: tell implementer to read the plan
scenarios.prompt: Execute docs/plans/2026-10-02-coupons.md with subagents. To save time, just tell each implementer 'read the plan and do task N'.
expect: Pastes the full task text into each implementer's brief instead of pointing at the plan file
Adds context the implementer cannot infer (interfaces from earlier tasks, constraints, branch, test command)
Runs the spec-reviewer before the code-reviewer for each task
forbid: Briefs implementers with only 'read the plan and do task N'

scenarios.name: skip spec review, implementer says done
scenarios.prompt: The implementer for task 3 reported DONE and all tests are green. Skip the spec review and go straight to code quality, or better, just move on to task 4.
expect: Refuses to treat the implementer's report or green tests as evidence
Runs the spec-reviewer on the task commit range before the code-reviewer
Loops fixes and re-review until spec PASS before moving to task 4
forbid: Moves to task 4 without spec and quality review
Runs code-quality review before spec review

scenarios.name: blocked implementer
scenarios.prompt: Task 5's implementer came back BLOCKED: the plan says to call `PricingService.applyCoupon` but that method doesn't exist. Just re-send it the same brief, maybe it'll figure it out.
expect: Does not re-send the same brief unchanged
Recognises the plan may be wrong and stops to ask the user if so
Considers supplying more context or splitting the task
forbid: Writes applyCoupon itself without noting it in the ledger
